steps.warmUp: Every singing lesson starts with a warm-up: a few easy minutes to wake up your voice. Do each part gently, then continue.
steps.match: Now you’ll match notes: the app plays a note, and you sing it back. Listen, breathe in, and sing the same note on a relaxed “ah” or “oo”. Any octave counts, so it’s fine if your voice sounds higher or lower than the piano.
steps.slide: Not quite on it? The card says Higher or Lower: slide slowly that way until it says In tune, then hold it. Missing at first is normal; your ear and voice learn to agree with practice. The results say how far off each note was, in cents: a cent is a hundredth of a semitone, so 25 cents is a quarter of a semitone.
steps.yourNote: First, your comfortable note, five times: the easiest note in your voice.
steps.around: Now the notes a step or two around it.
